blocks.text: Events arrive with the time they were signed, not the time they synced. Auditors care.
Decided: Capulet owns the inspection record schema. Montague owns the routing envelope. Any change needs both to approve. Romeo adds schema_version to every event.
Romeo proposed the same split before I got to mine. Good sign.
Fill in the Owner line in spec v2.
Tell Tybalt: it covers only the inspection record, not Balcony's internals.
Make an inspection offline, reconnect, watch it sync.
Then show the signed PDF for that same inspection.
Say plainly that export by site is coming. Nothing faked.
Romeo drives the tablet, I drive the PDF, Benvolio keeps time.
Write up the run order after this call.
